content: CSS Electronics CANedge: SD-card CAN loggers writing MDF4 (MF4), the de facto CAN industry binary format, far more compact/faster than CSV; ecosystem includes DBC decode, asammdf GUI/API, Python API for automated processing, MATLAB/S3 integration; CANedge2/3 add WiFi/LTE auto-upload for a fully automated archive-to-cloud pipeline.
